name: IPRF
aliases: IPRF (Intrinsic-Guided Photorealistic Style Transfer for Radiance Fields)
Intrinsic-Guided Photorealistic Style Transfer for Radiance Fields
definition: IPRF is a photorealistic 3D style transfer framework that leverages Intrinsic Image Decomposition (IID) to perform style transfer on radiance fields, moving beyond simple color-based transformations while preserving structural consistency.
